notes.title: Patch notes, 1.2.3 Steam release - Merchants and Wiches
notes.notes:
Patch 1.2.3 - Merchants and Wiches
In the world of Realmstone you can now find little huts that may either contain a helpful merchant or a wicked witch, both can grant you fabulous rewards but at what risk? A witches curse is no laughing matter. 

Become lord of the lands!
You can now claim ownership of your faction's cities by talking to their mayors, each city owned increases the power of your champions.

A lot of new features has been added but my main focus has been on fixing existing issues, adding quality of life improvements and optimizing server stability.

Changes

Server backup
Servers now has a save dated backups in a separate folder.
AI Aggression
Enemies will spend less time waiting between attacks.
Rain
Rain is now more visible.
DoT damage
DoT damage has been reduced by roughly 65%.
DoT stacks
DoT stacks now fall off as the duration decreases.
Arrow speed
Arrows are now bigger and travel 20% slower.
Missile range
All missiles travel slightly further.
Speech in XML
Npc speech is now saved as XML in the data folder.
Slower world travel
All movement on the world map has been reduced roughly 20%.
Potion vendor
Potions are now acquired by hiring a alchemist servant.
Chained risen
Chain attack has been reworked.
Channeled melee
A new type of attacks has been implemented (Frenzy for Berserker and [strike]Thousand cuts[/strike] Shank for Assassin).
You are not you own ally
Abilities that effects allies no longer hit you as well, some abilities has been reworked to make up for this.
Spider cult
The spider cult has been reworked and they now have spider totems that spawn spiderlings.
Urgerised
Urgerisen liches now has access to flamestorm, a new type of spell and Urgerisen zombies can now make themselves explode.
Plague zombies
Plague has been reworked and now causes damage over time and snare.
Wyldoverload
Some shaman can now overload themselves with wyld energies causing massive explosions (new ability type).
Wizard
A new neutral class  with access to slow travelling orb attacks.
Focus/Pray
Generator for clerics and sages has been completely reworked, this is now a self cast ability that generates energy.
Precision tool tip
Precision is now included in ability tool tip calculations.
Fire effect
The burning effect is now more visible.
Ray attacks
Ray attacks have had a massive visual overhaul.
Merchants and Witches
Old huts now spawn on the map, these will contain either a neutral merchant, that will sell you am item based on your champion level, or an aggressive witch.
Loot
The random loot generator has been completely reworked and is now based on the random item upgrades from the crafting engine.
Farewell Parnassus
The faithless neutral faction is no longer a player faction.
Missile angles
Missile angle can be changed during the cast animation, this should make slow cast missiles a lot more viable.
Player cities
You can now buy the cities owned by your faction by talking to a new mayor npc found in all cities not overrun by monsters. Talking to a mayor in a city you already own, will open a menu from which you can control what the city should build. Beware though, the less gold a city has, the easier it is for another player to buy the title from you.
Donations
You can now donate money to a city by finding the city gold stack and interacting with it.
House power
Each house now has a new House power stat, this is a percentage that is added to all that houses champions health and damage dealt. You can increase you house power by claiming cities, hover your mouse over you house power to see your current holdings.


Fixes

Server time step fix
Server time between updates is now more rigidly monitored to prevent loss of 'frames' and desynchronization.
Ghosts Champions
Champions should no longer ghost in the middle of the world map.
Arcane light fix
Arcane light should no longer go out when reapplied.
Resource turn in
Opening inventory after entering home town should now display the correct amount of resources.
Speed calculations
All haste, snare and root calculations have been reworked, this should hopefully put an end to speed calculations bugging when equipping haste abilities while being snared.
AI Performance
Enemies are a lot less likely to get confused in a target rich environment.
Wider banners
Champion name banners now fit their name.
